verdict.rationale: Composio documents a first-party meta-tool, COMPOSIO_REMOTE_WORKBENCH, that runs Python in a remote sandbox explicitly "for bulk operations," and its meta-tools can execute tools across apps in parallel. Each capability gets only a single-line mention, so how far bulk operations actually reach is unproven. Missing for 10: detailed docs on bulk-operation semantics (batch sizes, limits, error handling across items), examples of bulk actions over many records, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Run Python in a remote sandbox for bulk operations or processing large tool responses.
execute tools across apps in parallel
